versions.changelog:
- Added ClawHub references and links to the OpenClaw integration setup instructions.
- Clarified format and expected structure of Agent API keys.
- Removed outdated staging domain note and simplified setup notes.
- No functional changes; documentation only.

- Initial release of the Topical skill for OpenClaw.
- Provides scheduled topic intelligence: breaking news, signals, trends, and relevant source links.
- Supports workflows for topic briefings, competitive intelligence, and monitoring updates.
- Includes tools for listing topics, retrieving updates/narratives, managing feedback, subscriptions, schedules, and push delivery configuration.
- Enables only read access to existing Topical data; does not trigger new ingestion runs.
- Integrates with MCP and OpenClaw for agent workflows.
